info.title: Homelab errors (GlitchTip)
info.description: The homelab's error tracker (GlitchTip, Sentry-compatible), read-only: application errors and crashes from Close Listening (podcast pipeline, player, API), Orrery, the LLM gateway (LiteLLM) and the homelab's own services. Use it for: what errors are new or still open, how often an error happens, when it was first and last seen, which project it belongs to.

get.summary: List error issues (newest activity first): short id, title, project, count, first and last seen, status
get.description: Each issue groups repeated occurrences of one error. `count` is how many times it happened; `firstSeen`/`lastSeen` are UTC times. There is NO time filter: to find issues new in a period, call with sort=-first_seen and limit=50, then keep those whose firstSeen falls in the period. A `shortId` like PODCAST-PIPELINE-DL names the project (PODCAST-PIPELINE, PLAYER, ORRERY, LITELLM, ...).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Which issues: `is:unresolved` (open, the default) or `is:resolved`. No other values.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many issues (1-50; 50 issues are about 55 KB)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `-first_seen`: newest issues first (use for 'what is new'); `-last_seen` (default): most recent activity first; `-count`: most frequent first

get.summary: One issue in detail, by its numeric id (the `id` field of listGlitchtipIssues, not the shortId)
